name: Thomas Fitzpatrick
bio: A Representative from Kentucky; born near Prestonsburg, Floyd County, Ky., September 20, 1850; attended the common schools; studied law; was admitted to the bar in 1877 and practiced; county judge in 1874 and 1875; member of the State house of representatives in 1876 and 1877; county attorney 1880-1884; elected as a Democrat to the Fifty-fifth and Fifty-sixth Congresses (March 4, 1897-March 3, 1901); died in Frankfort, Ky., January 21, 1906; interment in Frankfort Cemetery.
